title: Breadcrumbs in 4D
author: Timothy Aaron Penner, Technical Services Team Member, 4D Inc.
featured_technology: Subforms with On Bound Variable Change
Text arrays as shared subform state

historical_commentary.text: The 4DEVAL tag and PROCESS 4D TAGS (formerly PROCESS HTML TAGS) are classic 4D web-area/HTML templating mechanisms; they still work in modern 4D but the broader trend since has been toward richer client-side JS frameworks and, for forms navigation, native form/page objects — so this specific breadcrumb recipe is a valid but dated UI pattern rather than a current best practice.
related_updates: Modern 4D form object model (list box/subform improvements) offers alternative navigation UI patterns
For web contexts, client-side JS routing/breadcrumb libraries are now far more common than server-side 4DEVAL templating
